status: Bounded semantic review complete; structural and predefined contrast checks passed.
review_basis: Read every directive's full constrained values and description. Full-vocabulary alternatives were explicitly identified, not removed from the actual plan.
findings: Every directive explicitly selects U.S. residence. Numeric ages and age-category labels agree, and integer age support covers 0 through 110.
The 0-4 and 5-9 bands leave leisure interests unconstrained and select nonemployment. Older children have age-appropriate permitted interests rather than adult employment or advanced qualifications.
The one actively unemployed adult selects a nonemployed occupation; other explicit occupations and advanced qualifications occur only in adult bands.

The explicitly White and multiracial cultural-background selections agree with their race categories. The urban and rural lifestyle descriptions have matching settlement selections. State is not independently constrained against a conflicting region.
All four prospectively defined food/adoption endpoints have compatible singleton allocations and survive all 100 fixed sampling seeds.
Novelty-seeking and a selective diet coexist in one directive. Novelty-seeking does not require liking this particular food; no gazpacho rating is implied by this plan.
limitations: Coverage constraints induce illustrative joint combinations; their prevalence is not established by the supplied marginal figures.

The multiracial cultural-profile allocation adds two fixed people to otherwise weighted race draws. Across 100 seeds, the multiracial mean is 3.34 of 50 rather than the source-weight expectation of 1.45. This is a demographic distortion, not evidence of representativeness.
All eight older-adult allocations select bachelor's-or-higher attainment. The supplied marginals do not establish that age-education relationship.
Uniform draws over age 65-110 preserve supplied support but do not establish a realistic within-band age distribution.
The supplied demographic description identifies itself as GPT-4o-synthesized. Matching its rounded age totals is not empirical census validation.
This is one fresh model plan, not a reliability estimate over independent model replications or a full survey-calibration result.
cost_scope: One returned response at saved standard rates; unreturned timeout charges, if any, remain unknown and excluded.
